lines.t: Thank you very much.
In the rain, in the window glass
Every shadow fading fast
Heartbeat synced to the midnight grid
I was lost, but you knew where I hid
Through the noise, through the sparks
You were calling to my heart
You are the light in the static
Fire in the silence
Rushing through my spirit like a wave
Yeah, who you are
You are holy, breaking every boundary
Pulling me into your endless grace
City lights and a thousand screens
Stood your presence, burns in between
Every cold line, every broken frame
You rewrite my soul with your name
Through the noise, through the sparks
You were calling to my heart
Heart, heart, heart
You are the light in the static
Fire in the silence
Rushing through my spirit like a wave
Now hold me to earth
You are holy
Breaking every boundary
Put me into your endless grace
Rise like power
Move like thunder
Every chain falls under
Let your kingdom come
You will be done
On the pulse of the drum
You are the light in the static
Fire in the silence
Rush through my spirit like a wave
Yahushua, you are holy
Breaking every boundary
Calling me into your endless grace
Thank you.
